remarks:
Excellent hunting and recreational land with a building lot consisting of 10.8 acres located in Gowanda NY, Cattaraugus County.

The land is a mixture of hardwoods and pines with a nice open building lot area right off the road.  The open building lot area is approximately half an acre in size with plenty of room to build a nice cabin, home or even park a camper if desired.  The terrain is level at the front of the property with a slope down to the middle of the property.  The parcel has 755 feet of road frontage with electric at the road.  Whitetail deer sign throughout for great hunting.  The Point Peter Brook runs through the property from south to north and runs directly into the Cattaraugus Creek just up the road.  The property is only a couple miles away from Zoar Valley which has 2,978 acres of public land where you can hunt, fish and hike miles of trails.  This is a great property for the outdoor enthusiast.  Annual taxes are $1,139.21.  All rights convey.

This property is located approximately 6 minutes from downtown Gowanda NY, 26 minutes from Springville NY, 30 minutes from Ellicottville NY, 35 minutes from Dunkirk NY, 48 minutes from Dunkirk NY, and 50 minutes from Buffalo NY.
